My best guess is **I, Frankenstein (2014)**. The consistently dark teal and blue stripes, with occasional amber flashes, fit its [shadowy blue-and-orange palette](https://www.doblu.com/2014/09/25/ifrankenstein-3d-blu-ray-review/).

Answer: B
